prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: full-fidelity desktop web app direction comp, 1440x900 landscape
Primary request: Design the first viewport of Bork, a polished dog-themed short-post social app and resume project, using the category-standard social-feed layout executed impeccably. This is the familiar standing option, not the recommended unique direction.
Scene/backdrop: clean near-black app shell with a centered white/dark timeline, restrained navigation rail, and quiet secondary rail.
Subject: Bork dog social feed. Show dog mark and Bork title, navigation labels Feed, Profile, Settings; a composer labeled “What’s happening, pup?”; authentic short dog posts with warm dog portraits, timestamps and names. Use truthful demo copy only, no metrics or customer claims.
Style/medium: high-end modern social product UI, exceptionally polished spacing, typography, accessibility, and state clarity.
Composition/framing: 1440x900 straight-on browser viewport. Familiar left navigation, centered feed, subdued right context rail. Clear blue BORK action. Posts read instantly.
Lighting/mood: crisp neutral screen.
Color palette: #0f172a near-black, #ffffff paper, #1d9bf0 action blue, cool gray dividers.
Materials/textures: clean app chrome, restrained rounded feed cards, standard social icon linework.
Text (verbatim where legible): “Bork”, “What’s happening, pup?”, “BORK”, “Feed”, “Profile”, “Settings”, “Mabel”, “Found the sunny square. Claimed it.”
Constraints: desktop web interface; familiar posting and reading affordances; dog-themed copy; no fake traction; excellent craft; no landing-page hero; no dashboard metrics.
Avoid: copied Twitter/X logos or branding, generic marketing page, excessive gradients, glassmorphism, illegible text, invented features.
